verdict.rationale: Dagster is built for unattended execution. Schedules, sensors and Declarative Automation launch runs without a user present, a long-running daemon container drives them in Docker deployments, and an official `dg` CLI plus APIs allow scripted triggering of runs (e.g., dbt subsets). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running Dagster inside CI pipelines (e.g., a CLI command to execute jobs or materialize assets from a CI runner, or a CI/branch-deployment guide), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
